extensionDescription.message: Shows a ruler in the Thunderbird message compose window.

optionsIntro.message: Adjust how the ruler is displayed in message compose windows.

physicalPositioningLabel.message: Track the caret by exact visual position

physicalPositioningHelp.message: Uses the caret rectangle when Thunderbird exposes it, with a logical-column fallback.

shouldRoopLabel.message: Loop the cursor at the wrap column

shouldRoopHelp.message: Useful for plain-text composition where lines wrap at the configured column.

columnLevel3Help.message: Show numeric labels every N columns.

columnLevel1Help.message: Show small tick marks every N columns.

scaleHelp.message: Changes the visual spacing of ruler marks.

cursorOpacityHelp.message: Adjusts the visibility of the current-position indicator.

maxCountHelp.message: Upper limit for generated marks when the wrap column is short.

tabWidthHelp.message: Logical width used when counting tab characters.

nonAsciiWidthHelp.message: Logical width used for non-ASCII characters.

saveFailedStatus.message: Could not save settings. Open the add-on debug console for details.
